source_text: Domus in urbe murata intra annum redimatur; postea firma emptori. Tempus gratiae breve. Noli dormire.
thought_title: The walled house and the brief time of grace
orientation: Origen is applying the Levitical law about redeeming a house in a walled city to the soul's brief opportunity for repentance.
pass_a_gloss: [The] house in [the] city walled within [a] year let [it] be bought back; afterwards [let it be] firm to [the] buyer. [The] time of grace [is] short. Do not sleep.

choices.why: The subjunctive expresses the legal prescription of the law, not a mere possibility.
Firma is a predicate adjective with the dative of possession; the house becomes the buyer's permanent property.

choices.english: The time of grace is brief
choices.why: A terse nominal sentence; Origen applies the year of redemption to the limited period of repentance.
rejected: The time of favor is short

choices.why: The imperative of nolo with the infinitive is the standard Latin prohibition; the urgency is direct.

bible_refs.note: Domus in urbe murata intra annum redimatur; postea firma emptori

pass_b_english: A house in a walled city is to be redeemed within a year; afterwards it remains firm to the buyer (Leviticus 25:29). The time of grace is brief. Do not sleep.

last_rejected.quote: A house in a walled city is to be redeemed within a year; afterwards it remains firm to the buyer (Leviticus 25:29).
last_rejected.source_quote: Domus in urbe murata intra annum redimatur; postea firma emptori.
last_rejected.why: Source lacks citation; English adds (Leviticus 25:29) as if in original text.
last_rejected.fix: A house in a walled city is to be redeemed within a year; afterwards it remains firm to the buyer.
last_rejected.ruling: Citation is a valid editorial reference; 'as if in original' is speculative, not a demonstrated error.

last_rejected.quote: A house in a walled city is to be redeemed
last_rejected.source_quote: Domus in urbe murata intra annum redimatur
last_rejected.why: Source is jussive/subjunctive 'redimatur' (let it be redeemed), not passive indicative 'is to be redeemed'.
last_rejected.fix: Let a house in a walled city be redeemed within a year; afterwards it stands firm to the buyer.
last_rejected.ruling: 'Is to be redeemed' correctly conveys jussive 'redimatur'; periphrastic modal rendering is standard and accurate.
